blocks.text: IN “THE AMERICANS”, AT LEAST, THE SPIES KEEP THEIR CHILDREN WITH THEM.
EITHER WAY, THE FAMILY|SERVES THE SAME PURPOSE.|ON TELEVISION, IT'S SCENERY.|IN REAL LIFE, IT'S A HOSTAGE.
WITH TUOMI, IT'S THE OPPOSITE: HE LEFT HIS FAMILY IN RUSSIA.
AND THE FBI NEIGHBOUR|WHO LIVES RIGHT|ACROSS THE STREET?
THAT'S TELEVISION. THE FBI DOESN'T NEED TO LIVE ACROSS THE STREET. A LETTER TO AN UNCLE IS ENOUGH.
